item.title: Vincent Martin - Software Engineer
item.description: PDF Version vince@finalatomicbuster.net - www.finalatomicbuster.net Experience Link to heading Senior Software Engineer, Tekmetric. June 2021 - August 2022 Contributed to a heavily used React JS application for a SaaS company Designed and implemented new user friendly components to make users happier and more productive Redesigned legacy components to be more feature rich and easier to use Refactored app from using 3 different styling solutions to Tailwind CSS, simplifying code base for new engineers Simplifying heavily used class based React components by converting to functional ones utilizing hooks Added needed features to Express JS based REST backend Provided code reviews for peers new features Released code daily and dealt with the consequences of that!

item.title: About Me
item.description: Hey, my name is Vince, I love making interesting things with computers! Professionally I have spent the last few years being a full stack dev primarily focusing on front end as of late via React JS. Prior to that I was a network engineer at a variety of companies, a network security tester/researcher/Ipv6 subject matter expert for Verizon Business, and obtained my degree in Electrical Engineering (Bio-Electrical track) from Temple University in Philadelphia.
